title: Tallow could help solve Australia's fuel shortages
paragraphs: Australia imports 90 per cent of its diesel, which is vital for transport, agriculture, mining and more.
The disruption of global oil supplies from the Iran war has highlighted Australia's fuel import dependence and increased momentum for alternative energy supplies.
